records.title: ProLaViT: Learning Progressive Latent Visual Thoughts in Structured Latent Space
records.reason: ProLaViT replaces explicit visual-generation reasoning with latent-space derivation and says it avoids inference-time tools, but the abstract does not quantify runtime, token, memory, or throughput savings.

records.title: Intuition-Guided Latent Reasoning for LLM-Based Recommendation
records.reason: IntuRec improves latent reasoning trajectories for recommender quality; the abstract does not establish a connection to LLM runtime or serving efficiency.

records.title: CineCap: Structured Reasoning with Spatio-Temporal Anchors for Cinematographic Video Captioning
records.reason: CineCap improves cinematographic video-caption quality and benchmark performance without a stated inference-system efficiency contribution.

records.title: PearlVLA: Progressive Embodied Action-Plan Refinement in Latent Space
records.reason: Primary-text Sections 4.3 and Appendix C report that K=3 refinement raises policy-query latency from 156.6 to 198.7 ms on OpenVLA and adds 391 GFLOPs; the paper trades extra inference compute for VLA success quality rather than improving inference efficiency.
records.body_check: primary_text_read; relevant sections recorded in body_review

body_review.findings: K=3 increases OpenVLA query latency by 42.1 ms and GR00T N1.5 by 42.0 ms, adding 391 GFLOPs; outside the efficiency-improvement scope.

records.title: Orchestra-o1: Omnimodal Agent Orchestration
records.reason: Orchestra-o1 uses parallel subtask execution to improve multimodal-agent inference latency and cost-effectiveness; primary text Section 3.1 explicitly optimizes task utility under latency and monetary budgets.
records.body_check: primary_text_read; relevant sections recorded in body_review

body_review.findings: Agent orchestration optimizes utility under latency and cost budgets and uses parallel execution; relevant systems contribution.

records.title: RAIL: Rethinking Auditory Intelligence in Large Audio-Language Models with a CHC-Grounded Benchmark
records.reason: RAIL is a cognitive-capability benchmark for audio-language models; it measures behavior rather than inference efficiency.

records.title: From Player to Master: Enhancing Test-Time Learning of LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning over Memory
records.reason: MemoPilot trains memory updates with multi-turn GRPO to improve game-playing outcomes; no inference-system efficiency mechanism is claimed.

records.title: Whisper Hallucination Detection and Mitigation via Hidden Representation Steering and Sparse AutoEncoders
records.reason: Whisper hidden-representation steering reduces an ASR hallucination metric; it is an audio-task quality intervention, not an LLM inference-systems contribution.

records.title: From Prompt to Service: An SLM-Based Agent Orchestration Gateway for AI-Driven Virtual Worlds
records.reason: The gateway routes prompts with an edge SLM and separates routing from response generation; its primary abstract reports practical low-latency routing on edge hardware and improved efficiency versus using one model for both roles.

records.title: QoEReasoner: An Agentic Reasoning Framework for Automated and Explainable QoE Diagnosis in RANs
records.reason: QoEReasoner reduces human diagnosis time for radio-network faults, but this is application workflow automation rather than LLM inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: Uncertainty-Guided Graph Formulation via MWIS for Token Pruning in LVLMs
records.reason: The DOI and title identify an IEEE CVPR 2026 token-pruning paper relevant to LVLM inference, but the official publisher abstract could not be retrieved; without primary abstract text the contribution cannot be reliably classified.

records.title: CoMIC: Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Cloud-Edge Systems
records.reason: CoMIC bounds edge-agent context through hierarchical summaries and selective history re-expansion while offloading reflection asynchronously; primary-text Sections 1, 3.2, and 4.2 describe resource-constrained edge execution and reduced context consumption.
records.body_check: primary_text_read; relevant sections recorded in body_review

body_review.findings: Asynchronous cloud reflection with summarized and selectively re-expanded edge history bounds context; relevant systems contribution.

records.title: VESTA: Visual Exploration with Statistical Tool Agents
records.reason: VESTA dynamically creates statistical-analysis tools for scientific modeling; the paper targets data-analysis capability, not language-model serving efficiency.

records.title: SkillBrew: Multi-Objective Curation of Skill Banks for LLM Agents
records.reason: SkillBrew removes redundant, outdated, or harmful entries from growing LLM skill banks, which may reduce retrieval and prompt load; the abstract does not establish inference-time token or latency savings.

records.title: Why Far Looks Up: Probing Spatial Representation in Vision-Language Models
records.reason: Why Far Looks Up analyzes spatial representation biases in VLMs and proposes a benchmark, not inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: PointLLM-R: Enhancing 3D Point Cloud Reasoning via Chain-of-Thought
records.reason: PointLLM-R improves 3D point-cloud reasoning through curated chain-of-thought training data; the abstract gives no inference-efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Enhancing Visual Token Representations for Video Large Language Models via Training-Free Spatial-Temporal Pooling and Gridding
records.reason: ST-GridPool is a training-free temporal-spatial visual-token pooling method for Video-LLMs, directly reducing input-token computation while preserving spatiotemporal information.

records.title: Which Way Did It Move? Diagnosing and Overcoming Directional Motion Blindness in Video-LLMs
records.reason: MoDirect diagnoses directional-motion understanding and improves VLM accuracy through instruction tuning; the contribution is capability training, not runtime efficiency.

records.title: SurgOnAir: Hierarchy-Aware Real-Time Surgical Video Commentary
records.reason: SurgOnAir streams frames into narration tokens in real time without future access, a potentially relevant low-latency VLM execution pattern; the abstract does not quantify latency or compute savings.

records.title: FineBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Vision-Language Models for Fine-grained Human Activity Understanding
records.reason: FineBench and FineAgent improve and evaluate fine-grained human-activity understanding; the abstract does not establish inference-system efficiency.
